import numpy as np
coefficients = np.array([-1/60, 3/20, -3/4, 0.0, 3/4, -3/20, 1/60], dtype=float)

def pack_extreme_result(result):
    values = np.asarray(result, dtype=np.float64)
    if values.shape != (5,):
        raise ValueError("preprocessing must have shape (5,)")
    delta_t = float(values[2])
    valid_delta = bool(np.isfinite(delta_t) and delta_t > 0.0)
    log_delta = float(np.log(delta_t)) if valid_delta else 0.0
    return np.concatenate([
        values, np.asarray([float(valid_delta), log_delta], dtype=np.float64),
    ])
assert np.allclose(pack_extreme_result(compute_msd_preprocessing(coefficients, 4, 3, 1.0e200, -1.0e40, 1.0e40)), target)

import numpy as np
propagators = np.array([
    [[0.8+0.2j]],
    [[1.0+0.0j]],
    [[0.8-0.2j]],
], dtype=complex)
coefficients = np.array([[-0.5, 0.0, 0.5], [1.0, -2.0, 1.0]], dtype=float)

def pack_result(result):
    overlap, powers = result
    shape = np.asarray([overlap.shape[0], overlap.shape[1], *powers.shape], dtype=float)
    return np.concatenate([
        shape, overlap.real.ravel(), overlap.imag.ravel(),
        powers.real.ravel(), powers.imag.ravel(),
    ])
assert np.allclose(pack_result(reconstruct_projected_matrices(propagators, coefficients, 0.1)), target)
